notes.title: Some small bugfixes
notes.content:
Thanks to your help, some minor bugs were noticed and have now been fixed. Many thanks to all who have reported.

[list]
[*] Your chosen playername should now be saved correctly on all systems.
[*] Pyramid activation now works without problems on all systems.
[*] Even at 4:3 resolution, the tutorial is displayed correctly.
[*] Music volume adjusts correctly in the options during a break-in.
[*] Widescreen is now fully supported
[/list]

In addition, the difficulty level of the campaign has been slightly adjusted downwards.

notes.title: Big Campaign Update
notes.content:
Finally, the time has come! The big campaign update for Clou - Roll & Heist is here:
[list] 
[*] Many changes requested by the community (zooming/scrolling with keyboard, split music and sfx volume, loading screens etc). 
[*] Some bugfixes of minor problems (mainly highscore bugs on Mac and sound problems) 
[*] you can now play the first campaign in Clou - Roll & Heist. This includes:
[olist]
[*] a few small cutscenes for the storyline
[*] the campaign screen to shop and manage your gang between burglaries
[*] the campaign toolset during the break-ins which you have to use cleverly
[*] and of course three new big scenarios full of tricky special rules you have to master [/olist] [/list]As always, I welcome feedback and if you find any bugs in the game, feel free to contact me - I will try to fix them as soon as possible. But for now, have fun hunting for the Victoria tiara!

notes.title: Release fixes
notes.content: After the release some of you already reported some bugs. Thanks a lot for this, it helps a lot. These should be fixed now. Also a lot of thanks for all the feedback and proposals to make the game better! There's allready a list of things for the next release :) If you have any more feedback, please feel free to write me a message!
